reason: Every translation-only key is a test context's `context.skip()` inside a test callback (`it("…", async context => { … context.skip(); })`): test/api/api-mcp-caller.test.ts:141, test/daemon/daemon.test.ts:798, test/engine/catalog/checkouts/checkout-spelling.test.ts:43, test/engine/no-follow.test.ts:35 and :53. @vitest/eslint-plugin 1.6.27's resolveScope takes any plain-named parameter of a function passed to an it/test call as a test context, and no-disabled-tests reports its `skip` member: ESLint 9.39.5 reports all five (disabledTest at `skip`). The original only takes a context root named `it`, so it misses them. On the whole rerail-typescript corpus ESLint's keys equal the translation's (NOTES-typescript-04.md).
